tasks.gr7-personal-social-wellbeing-t1: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering self-concept, values, puberty, emotions, and decision-making. Ask scenario-based questions about managing emotions, checking myths against facts, and making responsible everyday choices.
tasks.gr7-physical-education-t1: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering fitness baselines, movement patterns, coordination, cooperation, and safe warm-ups. Ask learners to identify safe practice routines, teamwork behaviour, and ways to track fitness progress.
tasks.gr7-creative-arts-t1: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering observational drawing, texture, rhythm patterns, ensemble voice, and improvisation. Ask learners to identify artistic techniques, rhythm structure, and clear scene-building choices.
